title: Part Seven: The War Since — Deaths, Famine and the Courts

sections.brief: The course of the war from the siege to the October 2025 ceasefire; the January 2025 truce and its collapse; hostages and prisoners; the state of the ceasefire in October 2026. Figure: timeline.
The dead and how they are counted; destruction; famine; the aid blockade and the GHF. Figures: stats; counts compared.
The ICJ case and orders; the ICC warrants on both sides; the UN genocide finding; Israel's responses. Figure: comparison.
